requirement: The STM32 firmware writes the received frames to the SD card without losing frames.
item_tested: Rebuilt unit after the fix of the firmware of 2023
evidence: report Table 5.4, row B4 (tab:bug_taxonomy) [report-text, archived, public]; report Section 5.3 (sec:diagnostic_resolution) [report-text, archived, public]; report Table 5.3 (tab:evidence_state) [report-text, archived, public]

requirement: The SPI signals cross the optocouplers within the timing of the SPI clock of about 96.8 kHz.
item_tested: STM32 Diagnostics Board of the rebuilt unit
evidence: report Section 3.3 (sec:stm32_details) [report-text, archived, public]; savchuk2025 p. 22 [project-report, archived, not public]
note: The follow-on project reports that an oscilloscope check of the STM32 Diagnostics Board showed no unstable communication; no capture is archived.
